study_purpose: decide whether the frozen V2-A analog signal A(q) enriches large upside moves with an asymmetric payoff strongly enough to justify building a trading rule and a historical backtest; not an alpha approval, not a trading approval, not a long-data purchase trigger
declared_before_results_scope: no tail rate, tail lift, top-decile statistic or MFE/MAE threshold count of any group has been computed on this data for this study; the prior exposures listed under prior_exposure were visible at declaration time and are disclosed, not hidden
units: returns and excursions are fractions (0.10 = 10%); session offsets are XNYS session-grid indices
change_policy: any edit changes the canonical checksum and makes this a different study; new values go to d_agg_rules_v2.json with a new declaration

relation_to_v2a.v2a_modification_policy: V2-A rules, results, artifacts, code and documents are not modified by this study; this study cannot reclassify V2-A
relation_to_v2a.v2a_question: does A(q) rank excess_return_5 better than the equal-weight composite B0 (mean-direction, IC delta)
relation_to_v2a.this_question: does the top decile of A(q) contain more large upside excursions than the same-date universe, without a matching increase in large downside excursions
relation_to_v2a.hypothesis_status: a different primary hypothesis, metric, comparator and gate on the same frozen signal; not a re-test of V2-A's hypothesis

prior_exposure.policy: everything below was visible before this declaration; none of it is a tail-rate or a top-decile statistic, and no threshold below was chosen by comparing candidate values on it
items: V2-A D4 S-12: within-date mean MFE_5 by A(q) quintile Q1..Q5 = 0.0683, 0.0475, 0.0454, 0.0470, 0.0591 and mean MAE_5 = -0.0605, -0.0435, -0.0405, -0.0421, -0.0524 (arithmetic means, not tail probabilities, top quintile not top decile)
V2-A D4: mean IC(A) +0.017156 against excess_return_5, Q5-Q1 excess_return_5 +0.002089, 138 label-invalid queries of 66,300
Strategy C prevalidation GATE-C2: a different selection signal showed MFE lift 1.36 with no 10-day close excess, i.e. the lift was volatility
Strategy C V2B: classified as VOLATILITY (log-symmetric, clustered true range)
prior_exposure.consequence: the known quintile pattern is U-shaped in both MFE and MAE and the top quintile's mean MFE/|MAE| ratio (1.128) is close to the pooled ratio (1.118); this raises the prior that any tail lift of the top decile is volatility, which is exactly what the asymmetry conditions H5, H6 and T4 are built to reject
forbidden_uses: switching the setup to the bottom decile or to both tails because Q1 shows the largest mean MFE
re-choosing the tail threshold, the setup quantile, the horizon or the comparator after the D-AGG-1 base rate is computed

data.price_basis: identical to V2-A: O, H, L, P are raw values divided by F(t), splits executed <= t
data.data_status: DEVELOPMENT / SCREENING DATA permanently; this is the fourth study to read the window (D V1, C-4, D V2-A, D-AGG)

signal.name: A(q)
signal.source: V2-A D3 signal artifact, reused as is
signal.definition: median of the accepted top-50 structure-analog neighbours' excess_return_5 (V2-A rules signal.primary)
signal.frozen_inputs: V2-A universe, ten structure coordinates, per-date percentile rank scaling, equal-weight Euclidean, K=50, library stride 5, caps 1 per ticker and 5 per end date, embargo d + h <= D - 60, same-ticker and same-FIGI exclusion, h = 5
signal.new_signal: none; no coordinate, weight, K, horizon or similarity change
signal.parent_binding: the D3 run whose COMPLETE token and identity bind rules canonical 2b060ceb...fe229; binding digest is computed over the signal_rows columns query_date_idx, query_ticker_col, query_ticker, sample_rank, analog_signal_A, signal_status only (b0, b0_strong and distance columns excluded)
signal.binding_reason: V2-A D4 section 11 measured that the b0 column differs by up to 2 ULP across machines (BLAS summation order); A(q) involves no matrix product, so the A-only digest is machine independent while the full signal_rows digest is not
signal.query_set: V2-A query set unchanged: 221 evaluation sessions (index 260..480), 300 hash-sampled eligible tickers per session

setup.name: HIGH_A_TOP_DECILE
setup.population: the session's queries with signal_status OK (known at D)
setup.rule: per session t, order signal-OK queries by A(q) descending, ties by sample_rank ascending; the first ceil(0.10 * n_ok(t)) rows form the setup
setup.selection_timing: selection happens before label validity is known; label-invalid setup rows are dropped afterwards and counted
setup.expected_size: about 30 per session, about 6,630 over 221 sessions
setup.session_drop_rule: a session with fewer than 20 label-valid setup rows is dropped from every statistic of this study (both groups), counted
setup.secondary_role: descriptive only, never a gate input

labels.shared_with: V2-A labels, identical definitions and validity
labels.window: sessions D+1..D+5 inclusive; D is never included
labels.sign_facts: H(D+1) >= O(D+1) and L(D+1) <= O(D+1) on every bar, so mfe_5 >= 0 and mae_5 <= 0 always
labels.close_return_5: P(D+5)/P0 - 1, clipped to [-1, 1] (recorded, not a gate input)
labels.excess_return_5: close_return_5 minus the session median close_return_5 of all label-valid eligible tickers (recorded, not a gate input)
labels.validity: V2-A: a bar on D+1, a bar on session D+5 itself, not label CA suspect
labels.clipping: mfe_5 and mae_5 are not clipped; every gate statistic is an indicator or a median, so extreme values carry no leverage
labels.capture_caveat: MFE is the best price the window touched, not a price a rule can be assumed to exit at; realized capture belongs to the trading-rule stage

events.symmetry: the downside threshold mirrors the upside threshold so that pure volatility selection, which raises both, is visible as TL close to or below DL
events.threshold_justification: 0.10 is about twice the known typical five-session excursion scale (about 0.05, the order of the V2-A S-12 unconditional means and of sqrt(5) times a 2.5 to 3 percent daily move), making UP10 a tail event while leaving an expected handful of events per session in a 30-name setup; 0.05 sits near the centre of the distribution and is not a tail, 0.15 leaves about one event per session in the setup and makes per-block estimates unstable
events.secondary_role: descriptive only, never a gate input

comparator.definition: every label-valid eligible ticker of session t under the V2-A universe rule (the same population whose median defines excess_return_5), about 2,600 names per session
comparator.overlap: setup rows are members of the universe (about 1 percent); this biases every lift toward 1, the conservative direction, and is not corrected
comparator.reason: the question is whether A(q) concentrates large-move candidates relative to picking any eligible name that day; the per-session comparison removes the session's market-wide tail rate
secondary: the session's full signal-OK query sample (300)
top decile of B0 on the same query sample
top decile of rv_20 on the same query sample
universe reweighted to the setup's per-session rv_20 decile mix
comparator.secondary_role: descriptive only, never a gate input

per_session.p_up_S(t): share of label-valid setup rows with UP10
per_session.p_up_U(t): share of label-valid universe rows with UP10
per_session.p_dn_S(t): share of label-valid setup rows with DN10
per_session.p_dn_U(t): share of label-valid universe rows with DN10
per_session.m_up_G(t): median mfe_5 over group G's label-valid rows
per_session.m_dn_G(t): median of -mae_5 over group G's label-valid rows

primary.name: TL
primary.formula: TL = sum_t p_up_S(t) / sum_t p_up_U(t), sums over the evaluable sessions, equal session weights
primary.reading: how many times more often a top-decile setup reaches +10 percent within five sessions than an eligible name picked on the same day
primary.why_ratio_not_difference: the threshold of a ratio does not depend on the base rate, which this declaration deliberately has not looked at; an absolute percentage-point threshold would have required it
primary.near_zero: the denominator is a sum over about 221 sessions of a rate of order 0.1 and cannot be near zero; a zero denominator is a HARD FAIL of data integrity

required.DL: sum_t p_dn_S(t) / sum_t p_dn_U(t), the downside tail lift
required.NTL: TL / DL, net tail lift; pure volatility selection gives NTL at or below 1
required.AG: R_S / R_U with R_G = sum_t m_up_G(t) / sum_t m_dn_G(t); median payoff asymmetry gain, scale invariant, so pure volatility scaling gives AG at or near 1
required.AG_near_zero: sums of per-session medians of about 0.03 to 0.05 over 221 sessions; per-session ratios are never formed

descriptive.levels: sum_t p_up_U(t) / T and sum_t p_dn_U(t) / T, the base rates, computed in D-AGG-1 for data validation only

statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over the evaluable sessions, non-circular, block length 20, 10000 replicates, percentile intervals
statistics.bootstrap_draws: strategy_d_analog.resample.block_indices(T, horizon=5, block_length=20, replicates=10000, seed=20260921), i.e. numpy default_rng([20260921, 5]); starts uniform on [0, T-20], ceil(T/20) blocks concatenated and truncated to T
statistics.bootstrap_single_draw_set: one draw matrix serves every interval in this study; numerator and denominator sums of every ratio are taken on the same resampled sessions in each replicate
statistics.seed_note: 20260921 is this study's own seed; the V1 seed 20260917 and the V2-A seed 20260920 are not reused for resampling (the query-sample hash seed 20260917 is reused because the query set is inherited)
statistics.family_wise: one primary metric at one threshold on one setup; no multiplicity correction is needed and none is applied

concentration.session_excess: e_t = k_up_S(t) - n_S(t) * p_up_U(t), observed minus expected UP10 events in the setup
concentration.ticker_excess: e_i = sum over ticker i's setup rows of (1[UP10] - p_up_U(t))
concentration.leave_top5_sessions_TL: drop the 5 sessions with the largest e_t from both groups, recompute TL
concentration.leave_top10_tickers_TL: drop every row of the 10 tickers with the largest e_i from both groups on every session, recompute TL
concentration.single_ticker_share: max over tickers of (ticker's UP10 events in the setup) / (all UP10 events in the setup)
descriptive: top 5 sessions' share of positive e_t
top 10 tickers' share of positive e_i
setup rows of the most repeated ticker
concentration.sector_theme: NOT_AVAILABLE: the store holds no point-in-time ticker to sector mapping (same reason V2-A excluded sector features); reported as a limitation, not a gate

hard.H1_sample: evaluable sessions >= 150, label-valid setup rows >= 5000, unique setup tickers >= 500, UP10 events in the setup >= 250
hard.H3_label_missingness: label-invalid share of the setup <= 0.02 and <= 2 x the universe's label-invalid share

T2_tail_lift_ci.pass: 95 percent CI lower bound of TL > 1.00
T2_tail_lift_ci.floor: 95 percent CI lower bound of TL > 0.95

decision.D_AGG_SCREEN_PASS: every H holds and every T meets its pass level
decision.D_AGG_SCREEN_BORDERLINE: every H holds, every T meets its floor, and exactly one T misses its pass level

gate.inverse: if the 95 percent CI upper bound of TL < 1.00 the result is reported as INVERSE_EFFECT and is FAIL; using the bottom of A(q) needs a new declaration
gate.first_failure_rule: H2 failing ends evaluation with FAIL before any other condition is read
gate.secondary_cannot_overturn: no secondary or descriptive statistic can change the verdict in either direction
gate.threshold_justification: T1 1.25 is the smallest enrichment declared worth a trading-rule stage (one extra +10 percent move per four expected); under the design noise model the TL point condition, not the interval, is binding at TL = 1.25. H5, H6 and T4 exist because a synthetic pure-volatility selection with zero drift produced TL 1.55 to 3.31 with NTL 0.90 to 0.97 and AG 0.985 to 0.991: TL alone would pass volatility. Leave-out floors at 1.10 require the enrichment to survive removing about 2 percent of sessions and the 10 strongest names

power.inputs: assumed base rate p_up_U in {0.06, 0.10, 0.15, 0.20}, setup size 6,630, design effect DEFF in {1, 2, 4} for within-session correlation and overlapping five-session windows of persistent names; no observed tail rate is used
power.se_formula: SE(log TL) ~= sqrt(DEFF * (1 - p) / (p * 6630)), universe side negligible
power.tl80_for_ci_above_1: 1.07 to 1.31 across the grid (1.23 at p = 0.10, DEFF = 4)
power.block_rule: P(>= 3 of 4 blocks TL > 1) = 0.95 to 1.00 at true TL 1.25, 0.3125 under the null
power.interpretation: sampling noise is not the main risk; confounding by volatility is, and it is addressed by H5, H6 and T4, not by more sample

secondary_diagnostics.role: descriptive only, reported in full regardless of sign, never a gate input
slots: X-1 TL and DL at 0.05 and 0.15 thresholds
X-2 TL, DL, NTL, AG for the top 5 percent and top 2 percent setups
X-3 TEP with its bootstrap interval
X-4 all primary statistics against the 300-name query sample instead of the universe
X-5 top decile of B0: TL, DL, NTL, AG, and the setup-vs-B0-decile TL ratio
X-6 top decile of rv_20: TL, DL, NTL, AG (pure-volatility benchmark)
X-7 TL and DL against the universe reweighted to the setup's per-session rv_20 decile mix
X-8 setup close_return_5 and excess_return_5: mean, median, share positive; universe the same
X-9 mfe_5 and mae_5 deciles p10..p90, setup and universe
X-10 A(q) decile profile of p_up, p_dn, median mfe_5, median mae_5 for all ten deciles (bottom decile reported, never usable)
X-11 concentration descriptives listed under concentration
X-12 per-block TL, DL, NTL, AG

additional: PA-1 setup selection reads only A(q), signal_status and sample_rank of session t, all fixed at D close by the audited V2-A D3 artifact
PA-2 setup selection precedes label validity; the module that selects cannot import labels

PA-3 mfe_5 and mae_5 of session D read bars D+1..D+5 only: truncating the panel after D+5 and mutating any bar after D+5 or before D+1 must leave them bit-identical (except that a mutated O(D+1) changes P0 by design)
PA-4 the universe comparator of session t uses the same eligibility mask as V2-A D1 for t; no future eligibility
PA-5 no statistic of this study is computed from a session outside the V2-A evaluation grid (index 260..480)
pit_contract.single_violation: any PIT violation fails H2 and the verdict is FAIL

on_verdict.PASS: authorizes D-AGG trading-rule specification and a historical backtest design declaration; no virtual trading, no long-data purchase
on_verdict.BORDERLINE: authorizes a written note (cost, realized effect, the missed condition, what the backtest would have to show) before any trading-rule work; no backtest without that note
on_verdict.FAIL: D-AGG closed for this signal, this setup, this threshold and this data window; the long-data question is not reopened by D-AGG
on_verdict.never: any verdict here changes the V2-A verdict

checksum_recipe: sha256 of json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8, i.e. app.backtest.strategy_c_selection.rules.canonical_checksum; recorded in d_agg_rules_v1.sha256
